items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: Keogh's wife, yeah, in New York.

ctx.x: We talked to his brother. He has a brother, Louie Tio I believe is his name. dear
Yes, I remember when she just died a couple of years ago. His wife? Keogh's wife, yeah, in New York.
Yeah, she came down here with the station. I told him I'd go play with Pete and his brother, Lafitte.
